name: Madawg

facts.text: Madawg: level 55, model 334, faction Siabras (the realm's largest monster faction, 503 spawns), at about 398,300/725,700 in the Bog of Cullen; respawn 80 seconds; a plain spawn with no script.

Unnatural Powers, two forms in the world data: (Torrance) 'Ask the locals of Alainn Binn about Ysberin', 'Slay the siabra magi Madawg who killed Ysberin', bring the staff to Lovernios; (Mavelle) talk to Lovernios the Druid Prince, 'Ask Ide about the dark magic that corrupted her friend', 'Find Saemus and retrieve the crystal', bring the crystal to Lovernios so the Druid Court may study it.
Living Server lore: Madawg as a siabra magus who killed Ysberin of Alainn Binn for her staff, and the Druid Court's interest in his craft.

story:
The Bog of Cullen lies under Sheeroe, and the people of Alainn Binn and of the Siopa fruit stand on its edge say the bog has been bad since the sky tore over the ridge, and was bad before that too, only more quietly.

The siabra are the realm's oldest trouble that is not a monster: the dark folk of the Veil's edge, half of the otherworld and half of the bogs and ruins, who hold more of Hibernia's wild ground than any other people that means the realm harm. Most siabra are reavers and thieves. A few are magi, and the magi are the reason the Druid Court in Tir na Nog keeps a watch on the bogs. Madawg is the worst of them in the Cullen country.

He killed Ysberin. That is what Alainn Binn remembers him for. Ysberin was the bog's own wise-woman, who kept the paths through the Cullen marsh and a staff of black bog-oak that she said had been cut before the bog was a bog; she guided travellers from Alainn Binn to the foot of Sheeroe and back for forty years and lost nobody. Madawg wanted the staff. He came to her hut on the eastern rise one night with the bog's mist around him, and in the morning the hut was empty and the staff was gone, and the people of Alainn Binn found her on the path she had kept, where the bog had been allowed to have her.

Lovernios, the Druid Prince in the palace garden at Tir na Nog, wants the staff back. He says he wants it so the Druid Court may study what Madawg has done with it; the people of Alainn Binn say they want it back because it was hers. Madawg has been working the staff in the bog since, and the bog has changed around him. The paths Ysberin kept have closed. The mist on the eastern rise stands still on windy nights. The druids who have gone to look say that whatever was in the bog-oak before the bog was a bog, Madawg has woken it, and taught it to answer him, and that the siabra of the Cullen country have started to come to him for the same lesson.
legend: Madawg is a level 55 siabra magus in the Bog of Cullen (about 398k/726k), Siabras faction, with an 80-second respawn. No script; a caster-style named, so interrupt him and do not stand in a clump. Other siabra camps around the bog are the same faction, so clear your approach. Unnatural Powers (the Torrance version) has you ask the locals of Alainn Binn about Ysberin, kill Madawg and bring his staff to Lovernios in the palace garden. A 50s group with an interrupter is enough. The paths through the eastern bog are poor, so come in from the Alainn Binn side and keep the group together in the mist.

aggro: The bog answers me now. Not her.
You want the staff? Come and take it from the mist.

loremasterTopic.text: The siabra magus of the Bog of Cullen who killed Ysberin, the bog's path-keeper, for her staff of black bog-oak. The Druid Prince Lovernios wants the staff. The bog has changed around him.

bookPage: From Derbáil of Ardee's list: the eastern rise of the Cullen bog, if the mist stands still on a windy night. That is Madawg. He killed Ysberin, who kept the bog paths for forty years with a staff of black bog-oak cut before the bog was a bog, and lost nobody. He came to her hut with the mist one night, and in the morning the staff was gone and we found her on her own path. The paths she kept have closed since. The druids say he woke what was in the wood. The siabra go to him to learn it.
